mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with a lower cost of capital for corporations, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% (as measured by the proportion of positive returns being less than 0.4), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% over the past 3 months signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1600 thousand units and an unemployment rate above 4.5% indicate a deteriorating demand and labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1600 and UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts level (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST is above its 1-year moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in the level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates stagflation, which increases uncertainty and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 205.0 and GDPC1 < 11500.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-supply regime (INDPRO < 110.0), manufacturing and services output is contracting, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
